description: State Rep. Ken Gordon is accepting applications for college level internships in his office during this summer. Internships at the State House are unpaid. Any college student is welcome to apply. Applicants with a connection to the Rep. Gordon’s district, (Bedford, Burlington, or Lexington) will be given preference. While each internship is unique and largely reflects the interests of the intern, the following provides a broad outline of the program: Summer internships run from mid-June […]
